observations: Single photo shows a large multi-section office machine with document feeder, color touchscreen control panel, and multiple paper trays on casters.
Front panel clearly reads 'bizhub PRO' and 'C754e' in white lettering (photo 0).
A small white label with text is visible on one of the paper-tray units but is too small/blurry to read any serial or spec details.
Machine appears used: dust, a plastic wrap bundle on top, and surface wear visible on trays and corners.
Background shows other copiers/printers stacked, consistent with a refurbishment or resale yard, not a clean office.
No power cable, screen-on state, printed output, or toner/drum compartment is visible to confirm working condition.

claims.evidence: photo 0 clearly shows 'bizhub PRO C754e' on the front panel, not C854e as stated in the seller's text

claims.claim: It is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a large multi-tray machine with scanner/feeder and color touchscreen, consistent with a color MFP

risks.risk: Working condition (print, scan, copy, fax) is unverified
risks.proof: A video or photo of the machine powered on, printing a test page, and showing page/drum counts on the screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / for parts

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch between seller's text (C854e) and photo (C754e) raises doubt about which unit is actually being sold or whether the ad text was copied from another listing
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating/serial plate matching the front panel model, and a matching invoice or asset tag
risks.if_unproven: treat as the lower-confidence, unverified unit; price only off what photo shows (C754e)

risks.risk: Usage level / page count (high page count MFPs lose value fast) unknown
risks.proof: Screenshot of the internal counter/page count from the control panel

risks.risk: Missing toner, drum, fuser, or other consumables not visible, which are costly to replace on this model
risks.proof: Photos of opened consumable bays showing toner cartridges and drum units installed
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full consumable replacement

risks.risk: Physical/internal damage from storage conditions (dust, damp yard) not assessable from one photo
risks.proof: Close-up photos of interior rollers, feed path, and exterior panels from multiple angles

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating/serial plate to confirm true model and resolve the C754e vs C854e discrepancy
Video of the machine powering on and completing a test print/copy/scan
Screenshot of the internal page/meter count
Photos of toner, drum, and fuser units installed
Multiple angle photos including interior/feed path
response.reason: The photo confirms a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e, a high-volume production-class color MFP, but the seller's text wrongly calls it a C854e, and none of the listed comparables (smaller office copiers from Sharp, Konica Minolta C223/224e/C283/C280, or a Ricoh MP C4504ex) match this production-tier machine's size or class even at worst case, so no comparable price can be responsibly picked.
